entries.title: Pressing Send while dictating stops and sends
entries.body: If you are talking into a box and press Send, the app stops the microphone, waits for your words to be written out, and then sends them. This works in Chat, comments, notes, both quizzes, Help, Feedback replies, Referee and Skim, among others. If the recording fails or comes back empty, it tells you nothing was sent or saved.

entries.title: A failed dictation retry no longer sends later
entries.body: If you pressed Send while a recording was being tried again and that attempt failed, the request stayed behind, and a later successful try could send your words without you asking. That leftover request is cleared now.
